reason: The plugin is best classified as a media tool: it adds a DeepSeek Harness `image_generate` tool that routes text-to-image requests through configurable OpenAI-compatible engines with fallback, applies per-session limits, and persists outputs as attachment references, with web-facing result and settings surfaces reflected in both the README and package manifest.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的 `image_generate` 图片生成功能，按配置在兼容 OpenAI 的引擎间路由请求并支持回退，返回可持久化的图片附件与会话级配额信息。
summaries.en: The plugin adds a DeepSeek Harness `image_generate` tool for text-to-image generation, routing requests across configured OpenAI-compatible engines with fallback and returning attachment-based image results with session quota metadata.

capabilities: Registers a user-facing image generation tool in DSH
Makes outbound calls to external image-generation endpoints
Stores generated image outputs as attachments
Tracks and enforces per-session generation/byte quotas

reasons.code: Manifest permissions include network:outbound, tools:register, attachments:write, and session:append
README documents multi-engine routing with health-aware fallback across OpenAI Images, CogView, and compatible endpoints
README documents durable attachment return format and per-session quota accounting for generate calls
Package manifest defines the `image_generate` capability and expected behavior (engine fallback, attachment refs, quota and attempts metadata)
Plugin description and metadata describe a user-facing result card and settings tab plus credential reference workflow
